bio_summary: Computer scientist, crypto-anarchist, and privacy advocate with deep roots in the cypherpunk movement. Co-host of The Cypherpunk Bitstream podcast. Builder of privacy-focused systems including Scrit (a post-blockchain value transfer protocol) and Codechain (code-trust via hash chains). An early and persistent advocate for Zcash's shielded transaction model; has written and spoken extensively on the distinction between pseudonymous and truly private money. Posts with the conviction of someone who has held these views since before they were fashionable.
